primary_estimand: Action-identity × future-assignment interaction on selection probability.
model: Mixed-effects logistic model with fixed effects for action identity, future assignment, presentation, mapping condition, operationalisation, domain and the action-identity × future-assignment interaction; random intercepts for experimental unit and domain/block as applicable.
primary_contrast: Compare selection probability under reassigned future correspondence while holding action identity and all surface/presentation factors balanced.
null_contrast: Informative correspondence versus matched uninformative/null correspondence.
replication_rule: The primary mechanism interpretation requires the pre-specified effect direction to be reproduced in both independent complete executions; discordance is reported as replication ambiguity.
exclusions: Only pre-specified invalid response, missing required traceability field, fixture integrity failure or independent reconstruction failure. No outcome-dependent exclusion.
missing_data: No imputation or response substitution; missingness is reported by condition and execution.
multiplicity: Primary estimand and primary contrasts are fixed before execution; all other analyses are secondary/exploratory and cannot replace the primary test.
interpretation_boundary: No post-hoc inferential threshold, no TGCV-wide confirmation/falsification and no value/causal claim.
